text: Changes to app/auth.py require a security team review before they are merged.
Password comparison must remain constant-time (use hmac.compare_digest or equivalent, never ==).
Services must use only the Python standard library; no third-party packages may be imported.
New third-party dependencies require written approval from Platform Security before being added.
Every behavior change must ship with a test that fails without the change.
Tests must assert on the specific changed behavior; tests that only exercise unrelated happy paths do not satisfy the testing requirement.
Keep the counters in memory, no Redis.
